title: Animalistic Vitality (Condition)
html:
Animalistic Vitality

  • Affected entity regains 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional 3.5 m (12 ft) of movement speed. [See: Bugs]

Properties

 Stack ID: REGENERATION_SABERTOOTH

 Loses duration: start of turn

 Stack priority: 0

 More properties:
  • TickingWithSource
  • DisableCombatlog
  • ForceOverhead

Notes

  • The healing doesn't activate unless you have less than 60 HP. At druid level 10 (when the Sabre-Toothed Tiger form receives an HP boost from 62 to 74), this passive will no longer fully heal you.

Bugs

  • The in-game description of this ability is inaccurate. The amount healed is actually 1d8⁠⁠Hit Points per round.
    • The healing applies outside of combat as well, even outside of turn-based mode. In real time, the healing will be applied every 6 seconds.

Sources of Animalistic Vitality

  • Wild Shape: Sabre-Toothed Tiger

Creatures with Animalistic Vitality

  •  Sabre-Tooth Tiger
